#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll mod = 1000000007;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

ll lcm(ll a, ll b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

ll mod_pow(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % m;
        x = (x * x) % m;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll mod_inv(ll a, ll m) {
    return mod_pow(a, m - 2, m);
}

// Combination class simplified
struct Comb {
    vector<ll> fac, invfac, inv;
    Comb(int n, ll mod) {
        fac.resize(n + 1);
        invfac.resize(n + 1);
        inv.resize(n + 1);
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) inv[i] = (mod - mod / i) * inv[mod % i] % mod;
        invfac[0] = invfac[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) invfac[i] = (invfac[i - 1] * inv[i]) % mod;
    }
    ll nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fac[n] * invfac[r] % mod * invfac[n - r] % mod;
    }
};

// Disjoint Union Sets
struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        rank.resize(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    void unite(int x, int y) {
        int px = find(x), py = find(y);
        if (px == py) return;
        if (rank[px] < rank[py]) parent[px] = py;
        else if (rank[py] < rank[px]) parent[py] = px;
        else {
            parent[py] = px;
            rank[px]++;
        }
    }
};

// Min sparse table
struct SparseTable {
    vector<vector<ll>> st;
    vector<int> log;
    SparseTable(const vector<ll>& a) {
        int n = a.size();
        log.resize(n + 2);
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) log[i] = log[i / 2] + 1;
        int k = log[n] + 1;
        st.assign(n, vector<ll>(k));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) st[i][0] = a[i];
        for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i + (1 << j) <= n; i++) {
                st[i][j] = min(st[i][j - 1], st[i + (1 << (j - 1))][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    ll query(int l, int r) {
        int j = log[r - l + 1];
        return min(st[l][j], st[r - (1 << j) + 1][j]);
    }
};

bool flag;
ll back(char *arr, int n) {
    ll tot = 0;
    auto isFixed = [=](int i) { return arr[i] != '_'; };
    if (isFixed(n - 1) && isFixed(n - 2)) {
        ll num = 10 * (arr[n - 2] - '0') + (arr[n - 1] - '0');
        if (num % 25 == 0) {
            if (num == 0) flag = true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else if (arr[n - 1] == '_' && arr[n - 2] == '_') {
        flag = true;
        return 4;
    } else if (arr[n - 1] == '_') {
        if (arr[n - 2] == '2' || arr[n - 2] == '0' || arr[n - 2] == '7' || arr[n - 2] == '5') {
            if (arr[n - 2] == '0') flag = true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else {
        if (arr[n - 1] == '0' || arr[n - 1] == '5') {
            if (arr[n - 1] == '0') flag = true;
            return 2;
        } else return 0;
    }
}

void solve() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int n = s.length();
    // handle n==1
    if (n == 1) {
        if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') cout << "1\n";
        else cout << "0\n";
        return;
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') {
        cout << "0\n";
        return;
    }
    bool hasX = false;
    for (char c : s) if (c == 'X') { hasX = true; break; }
    ll tot = 0;
    if (hasX) {
        for (int x = 0; x <= 9; x++) {
            if (s[0] == 'X' && x == 0) continue;
            string t = s;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) if (t[j] == 'X') t[j] = '0' + x;
            char *arr = &t[0];
            flag = false;
            ll ways = back(arr, n);
            ll pre = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
                if (arr[j] == '_') {
                    if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                    else pre *= 10;
                }
            }
            tot += pre * ways;
            if (pre == 1 && flag) tot--;
        }
    } else {
        char *arr = const_cast<char*>(s.c_str());
        flag = false;
        ll ways = back(arr, n);
        ll pre = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n - 2; j++) {
            if (arr[j] == '_') {
                if (j == 0) pre *= 9;
                else pre *= 10;
            }
        }
        tot += pre * ways;
        if (pre == 1 && flag) tot--;
    }
    cout << tot << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int tc = 1;
    // possibly multiple test cases, but code originally only one
    // tc = sc.nextInt(); // uncomment if needed
    for (int i = 0; i < tc; i++) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
